alt: Gmail notification from the FCC closing the bootloader lock ticket and referring the matter to the State Attorney General.
summary: An official email notification from the FCC Consumer Inquiries and Complaints division on July 2, 2026, closing Ticket No. 8840957 regarding manufacturer-level bootloader locks because device manufacturer disputes are outside their jurisdiction, and directing the user to the State Attorney General.
full_text: [FCC Consumer Inquiries and Complaints] Re: Bootloader Firmware Restriction - Manufacturer Level Lock Prevention. This ticket (#8840957) has been updated. Thank you for contacting the FCC with your concern. The FCC serves consumer complaints on telecommunications service providers. Unfortunately, the FCC is not able to serve your complaint because it involves a dispute with a device manufacturer or because the seller of your device or product is not a service provider. You may want to contact your State Attorney General's Office to determine whether they are able to assist you. Below is a link to the National Association of Attorneys General...
